text:
Hiro Tanaka: Hi everyone 1st day! Running into a weird combo: Okta shows me active but when I try to enroll MFA it fails with 'No phone number associated'. Also the 1Password invite landed at my personal gmail (hiro.t.personal@gmail.com) instead of my work email. Who should I ping to fix both?

Maya (IT): welcome Hiro :wave: That's two separate things but we can fix. For 1Password ping @Zoe (People Ops). For the Okta phone error, can you check your Okta profile (Settings -> Profile) and see if a phone number is set?

Hiro Tanaka: I checked profile, phone is blank and when I click "Add device" it errors out with a small toast: `Failed to add phone: 400 - missing attribute`. Using iPhone 14, Safari.

Zoe (People Ops): hey Hiro 1 welcome! Sorry about the invite mixup 1 we sometimes send to the email on the recruiter form. I'll revoke the invite to your personal gmail and send a new one to hiro.t@redwood.dev now.

Ben R: also noting that if Okta profile is missing the phone we can provision via admin console, but we need HR confirmation of your main contact number. Zoe, can you confirm the work email and preferred phone?

Zoe (People Ops): confirmed work email hiro.t@redwood.dev. Hiro can you DM me the phone number you want on file and I'll mark HR as confirmed so IT can set it.

Hiro Tanaka: DMed you the number. Thanks Zoe.

IT Support Bot: Ticket created: #INC-2211 1 Subject: "New hire Hiro - Okta missing phone + 1Password sent to personal email". Assigned -> Maya (IT). Priority P2.

Maya (IT): thanks Zoe. Hiro, I see the admin flag is still waiting for HR verification which explains the missing phone attribute. Once Zoe updates HR status I'll add the phone and push a new MFA enroll packet. In the meantime try the passkey flow (no phone) as an alternative — but since 1Password and device trust need MFA we'll push phone ASAP.

Hiro Tanaka: tried passkey enrollment and it prompts to select an authenticator but then shows `Enrollment blocked: account policy`. So passkey is blocked until IT flips a flag I guess.

Maya (IT): yep likely a policy block. After Zoe confirms the phone I'll: 1) add phone entry, 2) clear stale okta sessions, 3) force an MFA re-enroll. That should unblock passkeys too.

Zoe (People Ops): updated HR confirmation and re-sent 1Password to hiro.t@redwood.dev. You should get it in a couple minutes. I also revoked the personal invite.

Maya (IT): seeing the HR update now, adding phone and forcing the re-enroll...

Hiro Tanaka: got 1Password invite on the work email, set up account and enabled OTP MFA. Thanks Zoe!

Maya (IT): Okta re-enroll push sent. Please try MFA setup now and accept any mobile prompts. If it still errors, paste the exact toast or screenshot.

Hiro Tanaka: enrolling now... success! phone shows in profile and passkey enrollment also worked after the re-enroll. All set with Drive and internal docs.

Ben R: great, welcome aboard Hiro. If you need repo access ping me and include the repo slug.

Hiro Tanaka: will do, thanks everyone for the super fast help :pray: Appreciate the warm welcome!
